About CCASH

CCASH is the legal entity and technology platform behind a network of money-services operations. We provide the infrastructure — legal, compliance, and technology — so operators can launch under their own brand and graduate to full independence when they're ready.

What CCASH Is

CCASH is a whitelabel platform for Money Services Businesses (MSBs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs), and corporate-treasury operations. The legal entity — CCA.SH MONEY SERVICES (US) SERIES LLC — is a Montana Series LLC registered with the US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) as a Money Services Business under 31 CFR §1022.380.

item.title: Legal
item.description:
Company

Legal Framework

The legal foundation for CCASH money-services operations — entity structure, regulatory registration, compliance program, and operator agreements. US federal and Montana law.

Entity Structure

CCA.SH MONEY SERVICES (US) SERIES LLC is a Montana Series LLC (Montana Code Annotated Title 35, Chapter 8; series provisions under §35-8-304) registered with the US Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) as a Money Services Business under 31 CFR §1022.380. The Series LLC structure provides segregated compartments for each whitelabel client operation.
